description: Fetch ONE public web page and check up to 200 of its links and assets: broken links (4xx/5xx, hosts that don't exist, connection errors, timeouts), redirect chains hop by hop (long chains, loops, https-to-http downgrades), mixed content and links that may just block bots (401/403/429, flagged maybe_bot_blocked). Not a crawler: other pages are not visited. Private/loopback/metadata targets are refused, including names that resolve to them. Takes up to about 45 seconds. Returns counts plus up to 25 problem links. Read-only. Same engine and limits as GET /api/check.

assets.description: Also check images, scripts, stylesheets, iframes and media (default true). false = only <a>/<area> links.

url.description: Public http(s) page URL, e.g. https://example.com/. A URL without a scheme is treated as https://.

name: check_links

problems.description: Links needing attention (broken first, then blocked, unchecked, redirects with flags such as long_chain or https_downgrade, then other flagged links). At most 25 here; see problems_total.

status.description: Final HTTP status (omitted when nothing was fetched).

summary.description: Counts: linksFound, uniqueLinks, checked, ok, redirected, broken, blocked, unchecked, mixedContent, insecureLinks, longChains, redirectLoops, maybeBotBlocked, resolvesPrivate.

truncated.description: True when not every link on the page was checked (link cap, budget or time limit).

title: Check one web page for broken links and redirect chains
